newsitem.title: FINLAND: FINNISH MUTUAL FUNDS GROW TO FIM 11.6 BLN IN 1996.
newsitem.headline: FINNISH MUTUAL FUNDS GROW TO FIM 11.6 BLN IN 1996.

text.p: Assets in Finnish mutual funds increased to 11.6 billion markka by the end of 1996 from 5.2 billion markka a year earlier, the association of Finnish mutual funds said in a statement on Thursday.

If interest rates remained at current levels this year, the yield on assets placed in mutual funds investing in short-term money market instruments would be between 3.5 percent and four percent, the association said.
Assets placed in mutual funds investing in longer-term maturities would yield around 5-6 percent, it said.
